name: Yoku Dekimashita.
source:
Lovely tutor comes to main character for a 90 minutes study session. With clever approach it's possible to use these 90 minutes in various ways!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位可爱的家庭教师来到主人公家，进行90分钟的辅导。只要方法够聪明，这90分钟便能有各种各样的用法！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
